name: Butternut Squash

moderate.description: Becomes high in mannitol and GOS

siboNotes: Butternut squash has a very small safe serving size (about 1/3 cup). It quickly becomes high FODMAP due to fructans, GOS, and mannitol content. Use regular pumpkin (canned) or potato as alternatives for similar texture.
preparationTips: Roasting concentrates flavors, allowing smaller portions
Use in soups in limited amounts
